snippet.title: Bootstrap Island - Launch Trailer | Steam VR
snippet.description:
Bootstrap Island is a Robinson Crusoe–inspired roguelike survival adventure in VR. Shipwrecked on a ruthless 17th-century tropical island, you must survive without guidance. Trust your instincts as you face wild beasts, nature’s fury, and a mysterious local tribe.

After 2 years in Early Access and 5 major updates, Bootstrap Island is now available in Full Release on Steam!

Join the adventure:
🌴 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1942110/Bootstrap_Island/
🔥 Discord: http://discord.gg/x48uSXbUyv
😎 Merch Store: https://www.bootstrapisland.com/store

#PCVR #VR #survival
